Veteran-Owned
& Operated
Our Story

Service First.
Smoke Always.

DFW EatsNTreats is a veteran-owned BBQ food truck that has been serving Fort Worth since 2016. The name says it plainly — this is Texas Made BBQ: real smoke, honest portions, and a truck that shows up where the people are, from hospital night shifts to weekend evenings on Magnolia.

Ten years in, the recipe hasn't changed: do it right, serve it hot, and treat every customer like a regular.

  • ✓ Veteran-owned and operated
  • ✓ On the road in Fort Worth since 2016
  • ✓ Food truck service + event catering
  • ✓ Late-night stops — serving until 2 AM at JPS Hospital
